THE PREMISE
Marketing bought in pieces.
Nobody answerable for the whole.
Brand from one supplier, media from another, the website from a third. Each part is delivered competently. The value is lost in the joins.
It works — until something cannot be done twice.
03
WHAT EOV IS FOR
Twenty years of work that had to be right the first time.
A national event staged abroad on a fixed date. A retail season that arrives whether the work is ready or not. A category-first launch with one window.

HOW EOV WORKS
Three things settled before anything goes live.
01
Success defined before spend
The objective, the audience and the measure are agreed and written down first.
02
Measurement built before launch
Tracking and reporting are built and tested before the first impression is bought.
03
Accounts built in the client's name
Platforms, advertising accounts, analytics and CRM are created under the client's entity.
25
HOW AN ENGAGEMENT RUNS
One contract, one team, one point of accountability.
01

02
Build
Platforms, measurement and creative built against that definition, in the client's name.
03
Run
Delivery and reporting on a fixed cadence, with one senior contact throughout.
